title: HumanApproval
description: Matches the live code/schema inspection in docs/migration/01_verified_inventory.md and 04_data_dictionary.md (2026-09-25). No creation timestamp field exists on the live entity - only decision_time. The 'approved_with_edits' decision value assumed by an earlier reconciliation against docs/claimflow-luo-playbook.md does NOT exist in the live build - decision has exactly 3 values.

linked_resolution_proposal_id.description: Optional FK -> ResolutionProposal.id, present when approval_type is resolution_proposal.

linked_recovery_draft_id.description: Optional FK -> RecoveryDraft.id, present when approval_type is recovery_draft.
